title: Typed contracts are shown on dispatch and warned about, never refused
situation: The architect restated the concepts as name and differentia and cut implementation from them; this behaviour, which the concepts carried before, is recorded here so it stays bound.
decision: Each agent's assignment and deliverable contracts are shown to whoever dispatches or launches it, and an assignment given that does not fit is warned about with what is missing, never refused; the deliverable is bound as the harness's output schema.
consequences: A dispatch with an incomplete assignment still runs; the warning names the missing parts.
